non_blocking_observations.issue: Profile aggregate test asserts Teacher._count.likes, which counts likes MADE by the teacher (Like.teacherId relation) rather than 'likes received' on the teacher's resources as the ticket's Query-performance AC-3 phrases it.
non_blocking_observations.note: This is inherited from the locked contract (Interface 8 profile-aggregate pattern uses `likes: true`). The test correctly verifies the contract as written, and the AC is about the model's ability to support single-query aggregates, which is proven. Flag for the contract/consumer (#8/#13), not a tester defect.

non_blocking_observations.issue: truncateAll() in testDb.ts TRUNCATEs PascalCase-quoted table names; if the coder opts into @@map snake_case (permitted-but-not-required by contract Interface 1), truncation would fail.
non_blocking_observations.note: Contract default is no @@map (PascalCase table names), so the helper is aligned with the default. The migrations test already guards both exact and snake_case forms; only truncateAll is single-form. Non-blocking under the contract default.

coverage.acceptance_criteria: 21/21 AC bullets have >=1 test (Entities 8, Integrity 4, Query performance 3, Developer workflow 6). >90% threshold met.

coverage.contract_alignment: Verified against all 9 interfaces + 5 resolved ambiguities: 10 models (R1), ownerId (R2), db:migrate/db:migrate:deploy scripts (R3), status enum DRAFT/PUBLISHED (R4), fileUrl (R5), compound @@id on Like/BoardItem, Identity (provider,providerAccountId) unique, onDelete Cascade/Restrict, uncommented DATABASE_URL, postinstall+prisma.seed config, deps, docs/DATABASE.md, testDb helper shape.

quality_notes: Assertions are specific (P2003 FK, P2002 unique, exact row counts, DMMF field/index inspection).
Fixtures realistic via createTeacher/createResource/createBoard helpers with unique emails.

summary: Reviewed all 8 tester files: coverage of every ticket AC group and all 10 edge cases meets/exceeds the 90% bar, tests verify the locked contract precisely with realistic fixtures and clear assertions, and out-of-scope items are explicitly deferred with reasons.
